data.completion_memo: Implemented the trusted-core recurring-error aggregate and repair orchestrator without UI or platform switching. Failure recording is passive and resolves exactly one fingerprint group. Explicit investigations freeze a manifest subset and hard attempt/tool/token/deadline budget, require an authenticated exact execution receipt with frozen budget and observed usage, and delegate work through the investigation port. Candidate registration and every later handoff exact-read hash/size-bound artifacts; disclosures, user decisions, capability generations, enrollment, checkpoint, activation baton, safe quiescence, focused verification, bootstrap result reconciliation, rollback, regression, and same-Chat resume are typed and replay-validated. Event-driven idempotent redrives cover crash gaps without broadening authority or repeating uncertain effects; stale lifecycles, unsafe quiescence, displaced candidates/reports, wrong generations, and historical receipts fail closed. Independent strict verification passed 43/43 M10 and 70/70 trusted-core tests; Adashi QA job 10 run 28 passed.
data.description: Implement the core repair aggregate for recurring-error selection, bounded diagnosis orchestration, candidate evidence, complete disclosure, user decisions, activation-capability queries, enrollment requests, durable Management checkpoints, typed activation-baton handoff, protected receipt import, and same-Chat resume. Delegate all build execution to approved capabilities and all restart/rollback mechanics to the Bootstrap Helper; do not implement UI or platform switching here.
data.title: M10.3 — Implement the core repair aggregate and bootstrap handoff contract
